description.value: The Oaks Restaurant occupies Oak Bay's oldest building, a 1912 structure that once housed the Oak Bay Grocery and Post Office and later became the beloved 'Blethering Place' tea room. Established under its current name in 2012, it blends family dining with a touch of tradition: all-day breakfast, traditional afternoon tea with homemade jams and made-from-scratch desserts, and weekly live music nights. A touring cyclist arriving in the historic Oak Bay village would find a welcoming community gathering spot serving everything from burgers and haddock and chips to full English-style afternoon tea.
